theorem.complete_doob_packet: For each terminal partial-control increment Phi_k, Phi_k=P_k+sum_{r=k}^J G_{r,k}, where G_{r,k}=E[Phi_k|F_r]-E[Phi_k|F_{r-1}]. Hence E[G_{r,k}|F_{r-1}]=0 and E sum_{k<=r}G_{r,k}=0 exactly at every finite cutoff.
